status.en: 192 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Abuja, Plateau State and Lagos.
status.nb: 192 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Abuja, Plateau State og Lagos.

summary.en: Bandits killed four soldiers and 18 others in Zamfara and shot an immigration officer in Niger, while gunmen ambushed traders and security operatives in Zamfara, causing civilian casualties. ISWAP fighters attacked a town in Borno but were repelled after air strikes that killed more than 40 militants, including 25 neutralised and 40 fighters reported killed. A Kaduna family was abducted a week ago and bandits are demanding a 300 million naira ransom, prompting Atiku Abubakar to call for their swift rescue. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Banditter drepte fire soldater og 18 andre i Zamfara og skjøt en immigrasjonsoffiser i Niger, mens væpnede menn overfalt handelsmenn og sikkerhetsoperatører i Zamfara, noe som førte til sivile tap. ISWAP-krigere angrep en by i Borno, men ble avverget etter luftangrep som drepte mer enn 40 militante, inkludert 25 nøytralisert og 40 rapporterte drept. En familie fra Kaduna ble bortført for en uke siden, og banditter krever løsepenger på 300 millioner naira, noe som fikk Atiku Abubakar til å kreve en rask redning. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
